title: Training-window viewing-behaviour correlation preview
method: Pearson correlation after chronologically sorting each user's impressions. Past-behaviour values are expanding aggregates shifted by one impression, so the current outcome is not included in its own history.
usage: Explanatory demo diagnostic only; it was not used to select the recorded champion.

features.description: Number of earlier impressions for this user.
Share of this user's earlier impressions labelled long_view.
Average earlier play-time divided by duration, capped at 3×.
